cells.title: Egypt unified
cells.detail:
Egypt unified

Around this time Narmer (traditionally Menes) unites Upper and Lower Egypt and founds the first dynasty.

cells.title: Step Pyramid
cells.detail:
Step Pyramid of Djoser

Designed by Imhotep at Saqqara, it is the first large stone building in Egypt.

cells.title: Great Pyramid
cells.detail:
Great Pyramid of Giza

Built for Khufu. It was the tallest man-made structure for almost 4000 years.

cells.title: Old Kingdom collapses
cells.detail:
Old Kingdom collapses

Central power breaks down and the First Intermediate Period begins.

cells.title: Middle Kingdom
cells.detail:
Middle Kingdom

Mentuhotep II reunites Egypt under rulers from Thebes.

cells.title: Hyksos rule
cells.detail:
Hyksos rule

Foreign rulers from the Levant take control of northern Egypt and introduce horses and chariots.

cells.title: Hyksos expelled
cells.detail:
Hyksos expelled

Ahmose I drives out the Hyksos and reunites the country.

cells.title: New Kingdom begins
cells.detail:
New Kingdom begins

The height of Egyptian power and wealth, with the great temples and the Valley of the Kings.

cells.title: Hatshepsut
cells.detail:
Hatshepsut

Rules as pharaoh and sends a famous trading expedition to the land of Punt.

cells.title: Akhenaten
cells.detail:
Akhenaten

Replaces the old gods with the worship of the sun disc Aten and builds a new capital at Amarna.

cells.title: Battle of Kadesh
cells.detail:
Battle of Kadesh

Ramesses II fights the Hittites in one of the largest chariot battles ever recorded.

cells.title: Abu Simbel
cells.detail:
Abu Simbel

Ramesses II starts building the two rock temples in the south, guarded by four huge seated statues.

cells.title: Persian conquest
cells.detail:
Persian conquest

Cambyses II defeats the Egyptians and Egypt becomes part of the Persian Empire.

cells.title: Alexander arrives
cells.detail:
Alexander the Great

Alexander conquers Egypt without a fight and founds the city of Alexandria.

cells.title: Ptolemaic dynasty
cells.detail:
Ptolemaic dynasty

Alexander's general Ptolemy I declares himself king. His Greek dynasty rules for almost three centuries.

cells.title: Rosetta decree
cells.detail:
The Rosetta decree

A decree for Ptolemy V is carved in hieroglyphic, Demotic and Greek. The stone becomes the key to reading hieroglyphs.

global.title: Cleopatra dies, Egypt becomes Roman
global.detail:
End of the pharaohs

After her defeat by Octavian, Cleopatra VII takes her own life and Egypt becomes a province of Rome.

cells.title: Rosetta Stone found
cells.detail:
Rosetta Stone found

French soldiers of Napoleon's expedition find the stone near the town of Rashid (Rosetta).

cells.title: Hieroglyphs deciphered
cells.detail:
Hieroglyphs deciphered

Jean-Francois Champollion announces that he has cracked the hieroglyphic script.

cells.title: Tutankhamun's tomb
cells.detail:
Tutankhamun's tomb

Howard Carter's team finds the entrance to the almost untouched tomb in the Valley of the Kings.
